title: 8.2" Resin Blue Cottage Bird House
amazon_match_notes: Exact match: Santa's Workshop 38622, UPC 661565386222, ASIN B0BZLHPTLY. The Woot offer and comparison listings share the same 8.2" / 7.5"H x 5.75"W x 4"D hand-painted resin blue cottage birdhouse with thatched roof, flower boxes, and rubber cleaning stopper.

comparisons.notes: Sold as August Grove 'Annabellelee Resin Blue Cottage Bird House'. The product page description is word-for-word the same as Santa's Workshop 38622 (8.2" resin blue cottage birdhouse; 7.5"H x 5.75"W x 4"D; thatched roof; flower boxes; rubber cleaning stopper). The $39.99 price (was $58.75) comes from Wayfair category listing pages. The live product page returned HTTP 429, so stock was not confirmed on that page. Used as the lowest price to be conservative.

Santa's Workshop Inc. 7.5" Resin Blue Cottage Bird House, HSN item 20905408. Matches 38622: 4" x 5.75" x 7.5", hand-painted resin, thatched roof, flower boxes. The live product page loaded and is buyable with $7.50 shipping. $44.99 is from the live HSN Santa's Workshop brand listing.

writeup: Woot has the new Santa's Workshop hand-painted resin blue cottage birdhouse (model 38622, UPC 661565386222) for $19.99. It measures about 7.5 inches high by 5.75 inches wide by 4 inches deep, with a thatched roof, flower boxes, and a removable rubber cleaning stopper. Wayfair lists the same cottage as August Grove Annabellelee for $39.99, and HSN sells the Santa's Workshop version for $44.99 and shows it in stock. That is 50 percent below the lowest verified store price and saves about $20. Woot showed 10+ left with a limit of ten per customer.
